content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name == "docchat.chat.turn" | extend ttft = todouble(Properties["docchat.ttft_ms"]) | where isnotnull(ttft) | summarize p50 = percentile(ttft, 50), p95 = percentile(ttft, 95), p99 = percentile(ttft, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
content.title: Time to first token p50, p95, p99

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name == "docchat.chat.turn" | extend ttft = todouble(Properties["docchat.ttft_ms"]) | where isnotnull(ttft) | summarize p95 = percentile(ttft, 95), turns = count() by broadened = tostring(Properties["docchat.broadened"])
content.title: p95 with and without a broadened search

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.chat.turns" | summarize turns = sum(Sum) by outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
content.title: Turns by outcome

content.query: let b = AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.chat.broadened_searches" | summarize broadened = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h); AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.chat.turns" | summarize turns = sum(Sum) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | join kind=leftouter b on TimeGenerated | extend ratePct = round(100.0 * coalesce(broadened, 0.0) / turns, 1) | project TimeGenerated, ratePct
content.title: Broadened-search rate

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and Name in ("docchat.chat.prestream", "docchat.chat.rewrite", "docchat.chat.embed", "docchat.chat.search", "docchat.chat.screen", "docchat.chat.assemble", "docchat.chat.generate", "docchat.chat.persist") | summarize p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95) by Name
content.title: Pipeline step p95

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.search.duration" | summarize meanMs = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxMs = max(Max) by pass = tostring(Properties["pass"])
content.title: Search latency mean and maximum

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.chat.prompt.dropped", "docchat.chat.heartbeats", "docchat.search.rerank_partial") | summarize n = sum(Sum) by Name, kind = tostring(Properties["kind"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Prompt drops, heartbeats and partial reranks
